race.comment: COMMON TOUCH (9) is building a handy record, winning in Open 3YO company last start in a strong front-running effort. Fiore remains on board and he's drawn beautifully again down low. Can find the front again and make every post a winner. ZOURUN RUN (4) had no luck two back before rising to 1400m last start and scoring by 0.6L. Back to 1200m here, but she's a handy type on the way through and with a touch of luck early, she can repeat the dose. ASIF (3) has impressed at the trials coming into this, winning his latest heat with some lively types behind him. Pike's booking first-up is a good push, although he's never won fresh. Finds a suitable race and can put his best foot forward. MAGICAL SEQUENCE (5) was plain out in trip last time and getting a long way back. Now draws better back to 1200m and a better showing is on the cards. HEY PINO (6) is better than he showed last time out and can improve.
